description:
The year 2026 marks the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China (CPC). Xinhuanet presents "The Path to Success," a series bringing together leaders from political parties around the world to share their views on the CPC's governance practices and development experiences.
In this episode, Neema Majule, chairperson of Chama Cha Mapinduzi's Women Wing for Dodoma Region, said that the most successful aspect of the CPC is its ability to maintain a clear long-term vision while continuously improving the lives of its people. Such success comes from strong leadership, strategic planning, discipline, and its close connection with the people.

description:
At 26, Song Shilong wears many hats: college graduate, village Party secretary and livestreaming host.
In 2024, he turned down city job offers and returned to his hometown in Mengyin County, east China's Shandong Province, where he is combining peach farming with e-commerce and livestreaming to help local growers reach customers nationwide.
His new approach is bringing fresh vitality to a traditional industry -- and new opportunities to a once-remote mountain community.
title: Gen Z village chief helps sweeten life in China's Yimeng Mountains

description:
Brazilian music, dance and food lit up Beijing as the 3rd Brazilian June Festival celebrated the vibrant culture of Brazil.
We asked attendees one simple question: What it would be if you had to use one word to describe the cultural relationship between China and Brazil?
From "fun" to "possibilities," their answers show how people-to-people exchanges continue to bring the two countries closer.
title: One word to describe China-Brazil cultural relationship?
